description.text:
A **GRPO fine-tuned** version of `Qwen3.5-4B` specialized for **hospital crisis management** and **clinical triage decision-making**, trained as part of the TRIAGE multi-agent system.

This model serves as the backbone for a **6-agent hospital crisis simulation** that coordinates: ER Triage Agent — Patient severity classification (START protocol); ICU Management Agent — Bed allocation and overflow protocols; Pharmacy Agent — Drug order validation and contraindication detection; HR Rostering Agent — Emergency staff deployment; IT Systems Agent — EHR integrity and system failure response; CMO Oversight Agent — Override decisions and crisis governance.
